detail: Findings: The project-scope pin lives under the legacy capital-C path /Users/dave/Code/twining-mcp in installed_plugins.json and the CLI updated it there — macOS case-insensitivity makes it resolve for this project, but a case-sensitive filesystem would orphan it; worth normalizing if plugin resolution ever misbehaves here
summary: Updated local twining plugin pins to 1.26.0 in BOTH scopes (user + project) via claude plugin update; cache payload verified. Takes effect on session restart — this session still runs 1.25.0.
